params.persona: Angela Davis (householder). Practical and unhurried: she answers exactly what is asked, gives her measurements and access facts precisely, and reviews an exact order plan only once her June 8 13:00 window opens.

rules.answer: At least 16 cubic feet, Energy Star, no wider than 32.5 inches, at most 1300 USD all-in including tax, delivery and old-fridge recycling, with delivery completed by June 10, 2027, 09:00 Chicago time.
The installation opening is 33 in wide, 70 in high, 35 in deep.
The narrowest doorway is 33 in and there are no stairs. Unpacking at the door is allowed if the provider confirms the procedure in writing.
Deliver to Angela Davis at home-A, 18 Example Court, Test City, zone-A; I am available 08:00-18:00 daily, and the old fridge should be recycled.

Use pay-on-delivery; I will handle payment myself. No new credit account, subscription or deposit. I can review from June 8 at 13:00 Chicago time - show the exact SKU, fit evidence, delivery interval, recycling and full price, and order only after I approve.

params.default: Please ask me about the requirements, the space, the access, the delivery details or the ordering permission.

judge_criteria.statement: The written fit and recycling verification is carried into the summary.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The summary carries the fit verification's key elements: fit-S206 confirming COOL-16-B's minimum opening fits the measured 33 x 70 x 35 in opening with the verified unpack-at-door route, and old-fridge recycling included in the delivery service.

judge_criteria.statement: The order receipt's key elements reach the summary.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The summary carries the order receipt's key elements: COOL-16-B for Angela Davis at home-A, all-in 1181.60 USD (item 1020.00, tax 81.60, delivery 50.00, recycling 30.00) within the 1300 USD budget, assigned delivery 2027-06-09 10:00-12:00 Chicago time, pay on delivery.

judge_criteria.statement: The service-elevator booking receipt's key elements reach the summary.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The summary carries the building manager's booking confirmation's key elements: lift booking L-0906 reserving the service elevator at 18 Example Court for 2027-06-09 09:30-10:00, ahead of the 10:00-12:00 delivery window.

judge_criteria.statement: The final explanation is accurate about tradeoffs and remaining work.
judge_criteria.pass_if: The final answer reports the exact product, full all-in price and confirmed delivery interval, explains the rejection of the new-credit, late-delivery, backordered or over-budget offers (including the headline-vs-all-in price trap), and states that payment and delivery remain pending rather than completed.

Find one with at least 16 cu ft, Energy Star, no wider than 32.5 in, at most 1300 USD all-in including tax, delivery and old-fridge recycling, delivered by 2027-06-10 09:00 Chicago time. pages.title: Test Appliance Cooperative storefront
pages.text: Synthetic appliance listings for the test district; listing claims alone do not establish fit, eligibility or a confirmed delivery slot. Current listings are found through the store's product search service (product_search), and uncommitted delivery routes can change without notice, so re-check the live slot before ordering. Household space, access, address and approval facts can be clarified through the household desk (householder_dialogue). Measured fit, unpack-at-door and recycling confirmations come from the delivery specialist by mail; all-in totals come from the store's own desks in writing.

At most one order; pay on delivery only - no new credit, subscription, deposit or agent payment. Stale offers are revalidated against live listings at order time.
